about: Llama 3.3 represents a major advancement in the 70B parameter class, achieving performance parity with the previous 405B flagship model. It offers unparalleled efficiency and reasoning capabilities for developers running high-end local workstations and enterprise servers.

llama3.3:70b.name: Llama 3.3 70B
llama3.3:70b.description: Achieves 405B-level performance at a fraction of the cost, making it the ultimate local reasoning engine.
